It was a clear night, and we got a nice solid freeze. Panorama Loop, Tank Hill, Pretty Valley Road (from Aitkens down), Lower Horseyard Loop, The Boat Ramp and the Aqueduct in the Nordic Bowl have all been groomed and track set. The Nordic Bowl has been partially groomed and track set. High Plains Road is groomed and track set, at least 2 cats wide. the lower section near the dam wall is looking very average, hopefully we get a top up of snow soon! It is also clear until the first right hand corner from Windy Corner. It doesn't look like we achieved much, but I spent a good part of the night repairing and bolstering some of the troublesome spots to hopefully get us through this warm weather, the Observation Deck corner was looking worse for wear, but is now roughly half a foot thick. The Aqueduct just before the Dam Wall is getting very narrow and thin. I poked my head over the Dam Wall but it's looking very sad at the moment, not enough snow to groom, but there is a very narrow patch that can be skied on. The track setting came out worse than I would like, even after doing multiple laps to soften up the snow, but it is there!
